# Diff

Compare two texts by lines or by words.

Category: Text · ID: `diff` · Search terms: compare, differences, patch, unified

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui diff [file-A|-] [file-B|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. Text A (original) (argument 1)
2. Text B (new) (argument 2)

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--by` | `lines`, `words` | `lines` | By. |
| `--ignore-space` | on/off | `false` | Ignore spaces. |
| `--view` | `unified`, `side-by-side` | `unified` | View. Lines only; words are always inline |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/diff`), so they are what the tool prints.

### go-side-by-side

```text
  package main                   │ package main
                                 │
| import "fmt"                   │ import (
>                                │     "fmt"
>                                │     "os"
>                                │ )
                                 │
  func main() {                  │ func main() {
      name := "world"            │     name := "world"
|     fmt.Println("hello", name) │     fmt.Println("hello,", name)
      for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {   │     for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
          fmt.Println(i)         │         fmt.Println(i)
      }                          │     }
      // end                     │     // end
|     return                     │     os.Exit(0)
  }                              │ }
```

### go-unified

```text
--- A
+++ B
@@ -1,13 +1,16 @@

-import "fmt"
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+)
 
 func main() {
 	name := "world"
-	fmt.Println("hello", name)
+	fmt.Println("hello,", name)
 	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
 		fmt.Println(i)
 	}
 	// end
-	return
+	os.Exit(0)
 }
```
